records.choice: I paint a large red spiral on this object, clearly visible from across the platform.
records.caption: You find a moment to mark the old bench. The red spiral now stands out starkly against the weathered wood, a new, unmistakable symbol on the bus platform.

records.choice: I follow the road out of town toward Innsmouth.
records.caption: The road out of town stretches into the deepening twilight, winding away from the familiar salt air of the harbor. You leave the bus depot and its marked bench behind, the silhouette of fishing boats fading as you head inland.

travel.description: A desolate coastal road winding away from town, flanked by stunted, wind-battered trees and salt-stunted marshland under a twilight sky.
